informantions.title: Born Different: The Power of Sensitivity
informantions.story: From the earliest days of my childhood, I knew I was different. Where others seemed to adapt to aggression, noise, and chaos, I never did. My classmates could shrug off shouting, fights, or the constant buzz of distraction, but I felt every vibration of it in my bones.I noticed the hum of a classroom light, the subtle shift in a teacher’s tone, the way the energy in a room could change the entire mood. At times, this sensitivity felt overwhelming, and I wondered if it made me weak. But over time, I discovered it was my strength: the ability to process deeply, to see what others miss, and to think beyond the surface.

informantions.title: Forged by Frustration: The Persistence Within
informantions.story: This sensitivity shaped how I approached challenges. I often wrestled with doubt, especially when trying to master deep work. Many times, I failed to stay focused, and frustration made me question whether I was capable. I would sit down with the intention of working for hours, only to find myself distracted, drained, or overwhelmed by the noise around me. Each time, I felt like I had failed. But each time, I refused to give up. I learned to treat every attempt as training, every setback as a prototype. That persistence became my forge, shaping me into someone who can turn frustration into invention.

informantions.title: Stacking Victories: The Momentum of Small Wins
informantions.story: I began to see my journey as a series of small victories. A solved equation was not just homework — it was proof that I could push through complexity. A coded feature was not just a line of text — it was a step toward building something real. A polished design was not just aesthetics — it was momentum. Progress, I realized, is not about perfection. It is about stacking small wins daily until they become unstoppable.

informantions.title: A Legendary Vision: Chemistry as Adventure
informantions.story: Now, I channel that energy into building a chemistry simulation platform — a project that blends science, storytelling, and technology. My vision is to make learning chemistry feel legendary: every experiment a victory,every molecule a story, every detail a step toward mastery. I want students to feel like heroes in a mythic adventure, not just learners in a classroom. I want them to see chemistry not as a subject to memorize, but as a world to explore, a journey to embark upon, a challenge to conquer.

informantions.title: Shields of Clarity: Turning Noise Into Strength
informantions.story: School often drains me with its noise and negative energy, but I’ve built shields: headphones to block out distractions, grounding rituals to reset my mind, and focus anchors to remind me of my mission. I turn sensitivity into strength, channeling frustration into creation. When the environment feels overwhelming, I remind myself that I am not defined by the noise around me, but by the clarity I bring to my own work.

informantions.title: Building Myself: Growth Through Doubt
informantions.story: But my journey is not just about building a platform. It is about building myself. Each day, I wrestle with self‑doubt, perfectionism, and the fear that I am not enough. Each day, I remind myself that these feelings are not signs of weakness, but signals for growth. When I feel lazy, I ask myself what energy I need to restore. When I feel unmotivated, I break the task into smaller steps. When I feel overwhelmed, I pause, breathe, and return with clarity.

informantions.title: Rising Stronger: The Gift of Resilience
informantions.story: I know the road ahead will not be easy. I know I will face more failures, more doubts, more frustrations. But I also know that I will rise again, each time stronger, each time clearer, each time closer to my vision. I know that my sensitivity will continue to be both a challenge and a gift. I know that my resilience will continue to be tested. I know that my vision will continue to drive me forward.
